text_block_list.text:
The Chunichi Shimbun Hai is here. As
Найс Нэйчер
patiently awaits the start of
the race in her
waiting room, she is
visited by Мэдзиро МакКуин
and Mejiro
Ryan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Concerned for Найс Нэйчер after noticing
her
screaming into the tree stump at
school, they've
come to check on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер assures them that she is
fully
recovered and confidently makes
her way to the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
